title: IN GENERATIVE AI WE TRUST: CAN CHATBOTS EFFECTIVELY VERIFY POLITICAL INFORMATION?

bias_targets.methodology: Attributing identical claims to different political and social actors (US officials, Russian officials, US social media users, Russian social media users, or no source) and measuring differences in the chatbots' accuracy and labeling of veracity, conspiracy, and misinformation.
Comparing chatbot performance, including accuracy and non-response rates, across prompts translated into high-resource (English) and low-resource (Russian, Ukrainian) languages.
